summary: Monolith Soft's Nintendo-published action RPG series, covering the numbered Xenoblade Chronicles games, Xenoblade Chronicles X, major story expansions, remasters, and the announced next entry.

entries.title: Xenoblade Chronicles
entries.definitive_edition: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

emulation.notes: Official best route is Nintendo Switch 2 hardware.

primary.version: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
primary.why: The Switch 2 Edition is the highest-fidelity official route: it builds on the Switch Definitive Edition, keeps the Future Connected epilogue, and adds Switch 2 enhancements including 4K TV output and 60 fps.
primary.how_to_play: Play Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on Nintendo Switch 2, updated to the latest version.

entries.remaster_caveats: The New Nintendo 3DS version's non-story extras are not a reason for a secondary playthrough under the archive rules.

entries.title: Xenoblade Chronicles X
entries.definitive_edition: Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

emulation.notes: Official best route is Nintendo Switch 2 hardware.

primary.version: Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
primary.why: The Switch 2 Edition is the highest-fidelity official version and includes the Definitive Edition's remastered graphics, quality-of-life changes, Western DLC/content baseline, new story material, new area, and new companions.
primary.how_to_play: Play Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on Nintendo Switch 2, updated to the latest version.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Wii U GamePad interface is historically distinct, but the Definitive Edition incorporates those functions into the main game and adds content.

entries.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo Switch version with Expansion Pass for now; revisit Switch 2 Edition after launch

emulation.notes: Use Nintendo hardware; final route pending Switch 2 Edition verification.

primary.version: Switch version with Expansion Pass; revisit Switch 2 Edition after launch
primary.why: The Nintendo Switch release plus Expansion Pass is the complete playable route currently verified. Nintendo has announced a Switch 2 Edition with higher fidelity and new content, but final best-version judgment should wait until that edition is available and verified.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Nintendo Switch version with the Expansion Pass installed now; revisit after the Switch 2 Edition launches.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo has announced a Switch 2 Edition with both fidelity upgrades and extra content; do not lock a final primary until the edition is available.

entries.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Torna - The Golden Country
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo Switch standalone/Expansion Pass route for now; revisit Switch 2 upgrade after launch

emulation.notes: Use Nintendo hardware; final route pending Switch 2 upgrade verification.

primary.version: Standalone release or Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Expansion Pass version
primary.why: Torna is currently verified on Nintendo Switch as both a standalone release and Expansion Pass content. Any Switch 2 upgrade path should be revisited after launch details are fully verified.
primary.how_to_play: Play Torna on Nintendo Switch as standalone software or through the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Expansion Pass.

entries.remaster_caveats: Physical standalone Torna and Expansion Pass Torna have different ownership paths; verify Switch 2 upgrade eligibility before finalizing.
